description: The bar chart illustrates the GLUE Performance (y-axis, ranging from approximately 85.5 to 89.5) of various fine-tuning methods (x-axis: Prefix, Adaptor, LoRA, BitFit, S₁-model, S₄-model, S₅-model) when applied to two sizes of the RoBERTa model — base (blue bars) and large (orange bars) — as indicated by the legend in the top-left corner. For most methods, the large model consistently outperforms the base model, with the exception of S₁-model, where both sizes achieve nearly identical performance (~85.5). The highest performance is observed with the S₅-model using the large RoBERTa variant, reaching approximately 89.4, while the lowest is the base model with BitFit, at roughly 85.2. LoRA with the large model achieves the second-highest score (~89.0), followed closely by Adaptor-large (~88.1) and S₅-base (~87.0). The chart visually emphasizes the performance gap between model sizes across most methods, with the largest relative improvement seen in S₅-model and LoRA. Bars are grouped by method, with base and large variants placed side-by-side for direct comparison, and no sorting is applied to the x-axis categories.
